classification: single bounded development-only paired evaluation; exploratory, not confirmatory

decoders.A: one globally fixed correlation-aware PyMatching model using a single pooled detector-only calibration estimate
decoders.A2: per-root calibrated correlation-aware PyMatching using the matched root's calibration detector batch
decoders.B: per-root calibrated five-factor enumeration with background PyMatching; not exact whole-circuit maximum likelihood
decoders.C: privileged true-q five-factor enumeration reference; unavailable at deployment

estimator.method: training-only affine fit from mean five-triple-cofire detector feature to burst probability
estimator.coefficient_order: numpy.polyfit returns slope, intercept; V1.1 stores in that order
estimator.training_labels: known generating q values paired to training partition only

statistics.primary_estimand: equal-weight mean over q=0.01 and q=0.02 of root-paired LER(B)-LER(A)
statistics.zero_burst_safety: one-sided 95th root-bootstrap percentile for LER(B)-LER(A) at q=0; tolerance +0.0005
statistics.interpretation: development feasibility only; ten roots per condition are insufficient for confirmation

resource_limits.memory_metric_note: sampled current process RSS high-water; not a hard OS process-tree limit
